theme.description: Slate Black and glass theme with ONLY shades of black. Elite, monochromatic, brutalist tech, void-like aesthetic. VeLuX- ultimate Checker.
theme.archetype: Swiss Brutalist (Reversed for Dark Mode) mixed with Crystal Glassmorphism

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black uppercase text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl md:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-white
hierarchy.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold text-zinc-500

typography.rules: Never center-align body text. Use tight tracking for headings. Avoid 'Inter'. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all headings and numbers.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a faint SVG noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the main layout to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Optical Clarity' strategy. bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-2xl, and a strict 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10). No muddy grey transparencies.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or subtle drop-shadows (drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]).
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: For the admin panel, expose the grid. Use border-r border-b border-white/5 for table cells and dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.corner_radius: Sharp edges. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px). No pill-shaped cards.

layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch. No jagged bottoms.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 or p-12 for macro containers. Internal card padding must be p-6.
layouts.alignment: Mobile-First. Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align data tables and dense text.

motion.login_transition: CRITICAL: The 'NetherWorld' transition. On login success: 1. Login form fades out. 2. Background scales down slightly (zoom out) entering a pure black 'void'. 3. Text 'Welcome to NetherWorld......' fades in centrally with a tracking expansion animation. 4. Text fades out, and the Admin Dashboard fades in and scales up from 0.95 to 1.
motion.hover_states: Interactive elements must lift slightly (-translate-y-[1px]) and border opacity increases.
motion.micro_interactions: Use Framer Motion for layout transitions. Buttons should have a scale: 0.98 on tap.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10.
components.inputs: Shadcn Input heavily customized. bg-black border-white/20 focus:border-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white rounded-none. Text must be stark white.
components.cards: Cardless aesthetic. Flat rectangular surfaces. bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10.
components.tables: Dense. border-collapse. Headers: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500. Rows: border-b border-white/5 hover:bg-white/[0.02].

accessibility.contrast: Text over glass MUST have a dark enough background (black/60) to maintain APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Never use pure transparent backgrounds for content areas.
accessibility.focus: Explicit focus rings required for all inputs (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-black).

background_texture.description: Dark textured plaster wall for subtle background grit. Use at 10-15% opacity behind the main app container.

void_space.description: Night sky with stars. Used as an optional backdrop layer during the 'Void' transition.

3d_libraries_and_steps.instructions: 1. Install `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`, `sonner`. 2. Build the Login component wrapped in Framer Motion's AnimatePresence. 3. Build a dedicated 'VoidTransition' component that handles the 'Welcome to NetherWorld......' sequence using Framer Motion. 4. Use standard Shadcn UI primitive logic but strip Vercel styling (remove rounded corners, use monochrome colors).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: You are writing .js/.jsx files, NOT .tsx. Strip all TypeScript type annotations from Shadcn components if you import them. Build the app as a single-page flow: Login -> Void Transition -> Admin/User Dashboard. Ensure the theme strictly adheres to the 'ONLY shades of black' rule—no blues, greens, or reds. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use modern button styles relevant to the app style (in this case, sharp and brutalist).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
